extras: Local storage and vault sync compatible. Windows not verified. iOS acceptance pending.
intentEvidence: Record reactions while reading, revisit earlier thinking, and connect ideas across sources in ordinary Obsidian notes.
motivation: The author aims to help users record reactions while reading, revisit earlier thinking, and connect ideas across sources in ordinary Obsidian notes.
problem: Users often struggle to keep source documents clean while capturing detailed, editable thoughts and connections during reading.
summary: Marglow allows users to highlight, underline, and comment on Markdown and PDF files, storing annotations in editable local Markdown reading notes.
